governance: Machine-adjudicated SILVER labels only; never human/expert gold.
reason_for_revision: v1.1 validation gate failed: 9/12 re-annotated items still required adjudicator C (0.75 > 0.50 gate). Divergence analysis showed the dominant pattern is evidence-set granularity (one annotator's sid-set is a superset adding background sentences), NOT substantive conflict over the answer. v1.2 therefore replaces the exact-set-equality disagreement trigger with a two-tier rule: deterministic resolution for granularity differences, C adjudication reserved for substantive conflicts. The v1.1 prompt (R1-R7) is unchanged.
task: unchanged from v1.1 (all 75 questions, blind_packet.jsonl, v1.1 prompt_template with R1-R7 and qid echo)

tier1_deterministic_resolution: Applies only when A and B AGREE on answerable AND on evidence_role AND neither abstains.
If both answerable=false: final = answerable false, empty evidence (no C call).
If one sid-set is a subset of the other: final evidence = the SMALLER set (minimal-sufficiency principle R1/R5); record resolution='subset_minimal'.
If neither is a subset but intersection is non-empty AND Jaccard >= 0.5: final evidence = intersection; record resolution='intersection_consensus'.
Tier-1 resolutions are NOT called agreement; they are reported separately as deterministically-resolved granularity divergences.
tier2_adjudicator_C: both answerable=true and (intersection empty OR Jaccard < 0.5)
C sees document, question, anonymized labels, check results; C outputs final label or ABSTAIN.
disagreement_and_adjudication_rule_v1_2.rationale: Exact sid-set equality conflates granularity preference with substantive disagreement. The literature-standard practice is to report set-level agreement (Jaccard/F1) alongside adjudication of substantive conflicts; granularity differences are resolved by the frozen minimal-sufficiency rule, not by spending adjudicator calls.

metrics_v1_2: raw agreement on answerable (and Cohen's kappa)
evidence-set exact-match rate and mean Jaccard (descriptive, unchanged)
tier1 deterministic resolution count/rate (subset_minimal vs intersection_consensus)
abstain rates, format failure rate, API failure rate
validation_gate_v1_2: Re-annotate the SAME 12 validation items under v1.2 rules (v1.1 labels may be reused from runs/c2ges_stage2/validation_gate/ — only the resolution/adjudication logic changes, not the annotation prompts). Also retry the 4 items left unresolved by C read-timeouts (technical retry at a different time is permitted). Proceed to the full 75-question run only if the tier2 C-adjudication rate on the 12 items is <= 50%; otherwise stop and report.
stop_conditions: 5 consecutive auth or format failures for one model -> halt and report
served model id differs from frozen id (deepseek-v4-flash rolling alias excepted) -> halt and report
total stage-2 calls exceed the budget in STAGE2_AUTHORIZATION_20260807.json -> halt
ledger_requirements: unchanged from v1.1; outputs to runs/c2ges_stage2/; never overwrite pilot or validation_gate directories
